# @voidable/ui-react

> React wrappers for the Voidable UI web components. One React component per `<void-*>` element, with ref forwarding, typed props and typed `onVoid*` event props.

## Install and use

```sh
npm install @voidable/ui-react @voidable/ui @voidable/theme react
```

```tsx
import '@voidable/theme';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogTitle, Input, useTheme } from '@voidable/ui-react';

<Button variant="filled" color="error" onVoidClick={() => {}}>Delete</Button>
<Input aria-label="Name" onVoidChange={(e) => save(e.detail.value)} />
```

## API

- Naming: `<void-foo-bar>` is `<FooBar>`; its parts are components too (`<void-dialog-title>` is `<DialogTitle>`). Importing the package registers every element.
- Props are the element's attributes; booleans, arrays and objects are set as properties (`disabled={false}` is really false). `className` maps to `class`; `aria-*` and `data-*` pass through.
- Events: `void-change` becomes `onVoidChange`, `void-click` `onVoidClick`, and so on; `event.detail` is typed per component. Overlays take a controlled `open` and fire `onVoidOpen` / `onVoidClose` with `{ reason }` (`OverlayOpenReason`, `OverlayCloseReason`); set state false in `onVoidClose`, or `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
- `useTheme()` returns `'dark' | 'light'`, the scheme the page is in.
- Types: `VoidEvents`, `OverlayOpenReason`, `OverlayCloseReason`, `BarChartData`, `LineChartData`, `DonutChartData`, `GaugeData`, `GaugeZone`. Charts take `data`.

## Full reference

Every `<void-*>` element (parts, attributes with allowed values, events with `detail`, examples) is in the core package: `@voidable/ui/reference.md` (`node_modules/@voidable/ui/dist/reference.md`), summarised in `@voidable/ui/llms.txt`. Online: https://voidable.dev/llms.txt. Offline per element: `voidable ref <tag>`.
